content:
emma: quick thread — we're seeing tail latency on embeddings when clients send 1-3 items (dims=1024/1536). 95/99p up ~70ms during morning spike. anyone tracking? :eyes:

yoshi: probable cause = splitter overhead + continuous batching waiting for more items. small payloads pay tax.

sam: thought we had a tiny-fastpath? that's gated and opt-in. most SDKs don't send shape hints so router defaults to splitter.

emma: can we add a lightweight heuristics route that triggers for singletons with dims <=2048 but only for low-queue nodes? keep it conservative to avoid unit accounting surprises.

sre-oncall: accounting risk: skipping splitter changes how we bill units (splitter uses per-chunk units). we need a `heuristic_fastpath_unit_delta` gauge and a paired telemetry table comparing units_before/after over tenants. alert if delta > 12% for 30m.

kevin: console needs a way to show "heuristic fastpath exposure" per-route and per-tenant; a toggle to hide tenants with <1% rate. also show unit-delta heatmap so product managers can see billing impact.

yoshi: router pseudo:```
isTiny = (hdr=="shape=tiny" || (count <= 3 && dims <= 2048));
if (isTiny && node.queue < 3) route = HEURISTIC_FASTPATH; else route = SPLITTER;
```

emma: can we emit `router_reason` tag (HEURISTIC|HDR_OVERRIDE|SPLITTER) and `batch_fill_ms`? tracing will help validate if we reduced wait time.

sre-oncall: also add `heuristic_fastpath_rejects` counter for when queue >=3 so we can tune threshold.

console-bot: feature flag pipeline: `embeds.heuristic_fastpath` canary -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%. will post canary metrics automatically to this channel. :gear:

kevin: UX plan: small card under embeddings route. fields: %heuristic_fastpath, p50/p95/p99 latencies, unit_delta_pct, reject_rate. quick link to open tenant list where unit_delta > 5%.

yoshi: rollout plan: 1) add header opt-in in SDKs (default off), 2) enable heuristic only in internal canary nodes, 3) collect 48h `unit_delta` + latency + rejects, 4) decide widen.

emma: fine. add the header `X-Embed-Shape: tiny` for explicit opt-in. metric names: `embeds.heuristic.rate`, `embeds.heuristic.unit_delta_pct`, `embeds.heuristic.rejects`, `embeds.batch_fill_ms`. sre-oncall ok?

sre-oncall: ack. i'll add alerts: warn when unit_delta_pct > 8% for 15m, page if >20% and p99 latency regresses >200ms.

kevin: i'll mock the console card and throw a quick prototype into the staging dashboard once metrics are emitted.

emma: action items: yoshi - router gate + tags, sam - SDK header PR, kevin - console mock, sre-oncall - metrics + alerts. reconvene after first canary report from console-bot. :thumbsup:
